Hi Eva — really appreciate the thoughtful questions. Attached is a compact pricing sheet and a starter SOW that maps to the options we discussed. Quick summary below so procurement has something bite-sized:

Options (monthly list price, discounts for annual pre-pay):
- Standard (Self-serve): 99.9% uptime SLO, standard support portal, credits = 5% monthly invoice for > 1hr downtime per month.
- Priority: 99.95% uptime, 4-hour response for Sev1 (business-impacting); credits scale 10% for sustained outage windows.
- Premium (recommended for production mission-critical): 99.99% uptime, 1-hour response Sev1, named escalation, weekly triage call; credits up to 25% on rolling monthly SLA misses.

Triage/retainer add-on (example):
- 40 hours/month triage + named escalation contact + quarterly health review = $12,000/mo list.
- Annual pre-pay: we can offer 20% off the retainer line with a 12-month commitment.
- Multi-year (2+ years) or enterprise commit: additional flexible discounting available (we typically authorize up to 15% in AE-level approvals).

Regional note: list pricing is consistent across regions; taxes and billing currency can vary. EU customers often request separate data handling and an EU-resident escalation; that can be scoped as a regional add-on in the SOW.

Attached: SLA_Retainer_Pricing_v1.pdf (pricing tables + examples), MAA_Reqs.xlsx (answers to procurement questionnaire).

Next steps: if procurement likes the mid-tier Premium + 40h retainer, we can draft a SOW and issue a DocuSign for signature. Happy to jump on a 30-minute call with your procurement/legal next week if helpful.

Best,
